description_en: Adds devices to a sharing task
description_zh: 调用该接口添加设备到分享任务
kebab_example: aliyun iot add-share-task-device --share-task-id Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot-v6400000000 --product-key a2YwD23000 --iot-id-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddShareTaskDevice

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sharing task
parameters.name: share_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the devices you want to add belong.

You can view the information about all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
待添加设备所属产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The list of devices to add. Specify the IotId of each device. You can obtain the IotId by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey. If you specify both IotIdList and ProductKey, IotIdList takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
待添加的设备列表，需传入设备对应的IotId，该参数可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html获取。

如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey。如果您同时传入IotIdList和ProductKey，则以IotIdList为准
parameters.name: iot_id_list
